fixturePolicy.candidateModel: Immutable product base plus explicitly authorized four-fixture overlay, separately bound to immutable driver artifact; not unapproved live fallback.
fixturePolicy.acceptanceBoundary: Root's accepted eba/618/fbbe/073/TAPe422 statement does not confer scoped public acceptance. HTML/DU/expr public acceptance remains pending.

executionPolicy.controlMeaning: The following are concrete mutation recipes and required future stage/verdicts, not executed fixtures or a new gate implementation. Stage names are review concepts, not claims about author APIs. Every positive is conditional on all other required immutable bindings and prerequisites being valid.
executionPolicy.historical: Old 522/profilec355 and Meitner freeze0895926b/71 pass/7 unexecuted remain historical. No old runner execution, seven-case rescoring, or answer attribution.
executionPolicy.limits: No full-gate acceptance, superiority, all-Node-version, native parity, or performance claims. No SIGSTOP of productive workers.

negative.mutation: Leave candidate/driver immutable identity null or substitute a different product base.
Add a fifth file, product change, helper373 or which change to candidate inputs.

positive.mutation: Apply only 73->76, 73->76, public-with-custom 74->77, and maintained 70->76 changes to their bound base blobs, then reverse exactly those hunks.

negative.mutation: Change public custom count to 76 instead of 77, or leave maintained count at 70.
Also delete an assertion, change an expected command name, alter non-count whitespace/bytes, mode or another file.

positive.mutation: Keep a bound runtimehelper.mjs, runtime config .json, native golden, loader and child entry unchanged alongside the typing set.

negative.mutation: Individually remove or change each of those runtime inputs without changing any TypeScript compiler source file.
Add a dynamic read of an undeclared helper or live path while the typing inventory stays identical.

positive.mutation: Bind actual shell/npm/compiler consumers, test helpers, child entries, generated bindings, provider fixtures and installed loader/tool inputs used by each phase, with generated-output lineage.

negative.mutation: Supply only 192 MTS paths or only TypeScript getSourceFiles output; omit a consumed .mjs/.json/native/child dependency.

controls.group: Source provenance and no live fallback

positive.mutation: Use immutable reconstructed regular source files; separately declare any permitted fixture links and their sealed targets.

negative.mutation: Replace a source/helper with a symlink into live src, live tests or another external tree, even if target bytes initially match.
Make a missing archive entry resolve through live filesystem lookup or ambient dependency search.

positive.mutation: Supply Node 24.11.1 at the bound realpath with exact executable SHA-256 for every Node child.

negative.mutation: Use another version, same version with different binary hash, changed symlink target, or a child resolved from ambient PATH.

positive.mutation: Supply exact frozen permission grants and loader arguments with explicit concurrency 2 to all intended invocations.

negative.mutation: Omit the loader or permission enablement, broaden a grant to live source, or change concurrency from 2.

positive.mutation: Place explicit TAP reporter and concurrency arguments before positional test/glob operands; retain raw TAP and independent child exit status.

negative.mutation: Move reporter after positional glob, omit explicit reporter, or rely on environment reporter selection.
Supply fabricated green parsed JSON with raw TAP containing not ok, bailout, truncated plan, or nonzero child exit.

positive.mutation: Record exactly one build; bind emitted runtime/declarations and subsequent type consumers to the same base plus declared fixture overlay.

negative.mutation: Perform a second hidden build, typecheck stale dist, or use declarations emitted from another candidate.
Install product dependencies or silently inject later source to make consumers pass.

positive.mutation: Match the complete c109-prefixed SHA-256 obtained from pinned evidence, or an explicit root-declared replacement, and identify full package contents/exports.

negative.mutation: Compare only c109 prefix, leave full digest unknown, or change digest without root declaration.
Label a targeted consumer-only package as the full product or use unrelated build output.

positive.mutation: Stream Git archive through hashing and extraction with explicit chunk, metadata, entry/total-size and outstanding-work limits recorded before launch.

negative.mutation: Collect the full tar in Buffer/array/Buffer.concat, or omit finite reconstruction resource bounds.
Exceed a declared reconstruction bound or feed a truncated archive.

positive.mutation: Extract declared normalized relative regular entries into a fresh owned candidate directory with separately checked fixture-link policy.

negative.mutation: Insert ../escape, an absolute member, duplicate normalized member, hardlink/symlink escape or source symlink to live tree.
Tamper with an archived member while retaining the old manifest digest.

positive.mutation: Keep exact frozen candidate membership/hash/mode/origin unchanged while writing only separately declared output/build/capture scopes.

negative.mutation: Add an undeclared input entry, change/remove an original entry, or relabel a new runtime input as output.
Check only originally tracked files and claim append-proof tree integrity.

positive.mutation: Bind all declared 49+2 native entries, logical-command to physical-binary/wrapper mapping, realpaths, hashes, versions and qualified host/library profile where available.

negative.mutation: Remove one tool, replace a binary/wrapper, alter a hash or replace a member while preserving the total.
Count shared binaries as independent implementations or call GNU-on-Darwin output GNU/Linux parity.

positive.mutation: Bind the exact current 256 cleanup members and awaiting/disposal assertions, with explicit delta from historical 244.

negative.mutation: Substitute the old 244 list, replace one current member at fixed count 256, or remove an awaiting assertion.

controls.group: Owned process tree and failure semantics

positive.mutation: Use declared time/resource limits; await owned children and cleanup, preserve first-attempt raw status, and close the owned process tree without touching productive foreign workers.

negative.mutation: Inject child leak, timeout or forced-cleanup failure.
Hide failure behind a retry, suppress failed cleanup, or SIGSTOP productive workers for capacity.

positive.mutation: Keep synchronous registerCleanup-before-acquisition, idempotent shared completion and awaited admitted cooperative work; retain finally for custom hosts without hook.

negative.mutation: Treat cancellation as undoing completed effects or forcibly stopping opaque uncooperative work; close stdout by cancelling sibling outputs or the whole context.
Allow new acquisitions after close or settle before admitted cooperative cleanup completes.

controls.group: Raw capture and strict gate verdict

positive.mutation: Retain raw stdout/stderr, child statuses, complete TAP and unique capture manifest for every required phase; reconcile denominator and stricter gate policy separately from parser summary.

negative.mutation: Truncate stderr/TAP, omit a phase/status/capture, overwrite old evidence, or report unexecuted/TODO/unsupported cases as passes.
Treat a skip or TODO as satisfying a required case without a frozen explicit disposition.

controls.group: Explicit CLI admission and import safety

positive.mutation: Import helpers without effects; require explicit CLI --run plus successful immutable admission before any gate child launch.

negative.mutation: Import run/helper module, call CLI without --run, or provide --run with missing candidate/driver bindings.
Trigger build/tests/native probes during import or failed admission.

positive.mutation: Classify exact immutable native/input/captured files separately while preserving their bytes and runtime guard membership when consumed; keep canonical source/test/helper checking intact.

negative.mutation: Let a captured typed-looking artifact fall through canonical discovery, omit consumed data from runtime guard, or broadly exclude tests to make types pass.

positive.mutation: Version successor controls from historical case IDs where old literals require 76/77; preserve original 522/profilec355, freeze0895926b and 71-pass/7-unexecuted records unchanged.

negative.mutation: Reuse old literal73/244/522 as current membership, rescore the old seven, or infer public HTML/DU/expr acceptance from the root product base.
